content.text: Now I understand the substrate. Let me verify the C codec builds and matches `wire.py`, then design the new collector.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/project && mkdir -p /workspace/tmp/tb && gcc -std=c11 -O2 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter -Iinclude -c src/star4_switch.c -o /workspace/tmp/tb/sw.o 2>&1 | head -20; echo "rc=$?"; ls -la /workspace/tmp/tb
cd /workspace/project && time make BUILD=/workspace/tmp/tb -j2 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -la /workspace/tmp/tb
